services.name: Niagara City Cruises
services.desc: Explore downtown Toronto on foot, from Union Station and the PATH to St. Lawrence Market and Old Town, then finish on the waterfront with an optional 1-hour Toronto harbour cruise. See Toronto's downtown core come to life on a relaxed small-group walking tour that finishes right at the waterfront. Starting steps from Union Station, your guide shares stories of railways, skyscrapers, and sports legends as you wind through the PATH and past views of the soaring CN Tower. Stroll into Old Town to discover St. Lawrence Market, often ranked among the world's top food markets, where you'll have free time to grab lunch, sample Canadian favourites like peameal bacon sandwiches, or browse local

blurb: Gray Line Toronto offers guided tours from Toronto to various destinations including Niagara Falls, Niagara-on-the-Lake, and Algonquin. Tours include bus, boat, and walking options with durations ranging from 90 minutes to 12 hours. Guests experience local culture, natural attractions, and historic sites with knowledgeable guides.
